dominant_strengths: Tactile cinematic photography of cork, cutting mat, and pencil grounds the brand in artisanal craft and physicality.
Warm wood/green/cream palette is harmonious and unusual for tech-product sites, reinforcing the 'considered' product narrative.
Oversized display wordmark anchors the composition with confident scale, balancing the still-life imagery effectively.
dominant_weaknesses: Bottom navigation pill and intrusive cookie modal collide visually, fighting the immersive product hero for attention.
Body copy ('Designed to lift, insulate...') feels typographically generic next to the bold display, weakening hierarchy cohesion.
Right-edge 'O-1 MODEL' tab and floating UI chips feel bolted on rather than systemically integrated into the editorial layout.
fix_priorities: Redesign cookie consent as a slim, palette-matched bar so it stops competing with the hero focal point.
Refine secondary type with a complementary serif or tighter tracking to match the wordmark's editorial confidence.
Integrate the navigation pill and side tabs into a unified chrome system with consistent radius, weight, and contrast.
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral pull from the tactile photography, moderate reflective brand storytelling, but behavioral clarity suffers from cluttered floating UI.
rationale.intent_fit: Fits Awwwards scroll-driven product storytelling well, leveraging cinematic frames, though chrome integration prevents top-tier execution.
